question: On cases that need long-range evidence or conflict detection, does a routed team with a real checker beat a single agent at similar cost?

memory.note: The extractor reads the transcript in chunks of 40 turns, each chunk seeing the notes so far; built before the press, outside the card timing. num_ctx 16384 for memory calls only: the largest QMSum chunk is 10487 prompt tokens (measured) and Ollama's default window is 4096. The cache key is the meeting words plus model, chunk_turns, num_ctx and the extraction prompt, never the commit. Calls get 900 s each (not the extractor's 60 s) and two attempts; a chunk that still fails leaves the entry unfinished, to be redone alone, and the card run refuses unfinished memory. Why: on 2026-11-14 a game was using the GPU, generation fell to about 5-15 tokens/s, 60 s calls timed out, and Ollama kept generating the abandoned requests.

cases.files: datasets/raw/scenarios/e10/{dev,test}.jsonl (git-ignored: real meeting text; hashes are in the manifest)
cases.order: dev first, test once the configuration is chosen

card.note: Card calls use Ollama's default window (4096 tokens) for every arm, as in E8 and the product. Measured largest card prompt on the heaviest test cases (16384 window so nothing was cut): single 1019, team_shipping_changed 1560, team_routed 2376, single_plus 2118 tokens, all under 4096. A setting here would apply to every arm alike.
